instruction: I want to reduce the maximum volume limit in VLC to 100% to prevent accidentally damaging my speakers. How can I set the volume limit to a safer level?

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing VLC's maximum volume setting to 100 (qt-max-volume=100). Uses existing check_qt_max_volume metric to verify the setting in vlcrc config file. Default is 125, task sets it to 100 for safety.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic correctly extracts VLC config file (vlcrc) from platform-specific locations and saves to cache
Metric function correctly parses vlcrc file, searches for 'qt-max-volume=' setting with proper default value (125), and compares with expected value
Expected value (100) semantically matches the instruction requirement to 'set volume limit to 100%'
Complete coverage: instruction asks to set volume limit to 100%, evaluator checks qt-max-volume setting equals 100
Postconfig appropriately restarts VLC to ensure config changes are persisted and can be verified
Data flow is correct: getter extracts config file → metric parses and checks qt-max-volume → compares with expected 100
Metric function correctly handles rule parameter - directly accesses 'expected_qt_max_volume' from rules dict (not incorrectly accessing nested 'rules' key)
